title: Process Overview
description: Process values by plant area/unit/equipment. NOT AN HMI: this dashboard is read-only and cannot control anything. If it disagrees with the HMI, the HMI is authoritative.

list.name: resolution
list.label: Resolution
list.description: Raw samples are retained 90 days, 1-minute rollups 2 years, 1-hour indefinitely. Selecting a range beyond a source's retention returns nothing — which reads as 'the plant was off' rather than 'wrong table'. Pick to match your time range.
list.query: tag_sample : Raw (< 90 days),tag_sample_1m : 1 minute (< 2 years),tag_sample_1h : 1 hour (all history)

list.name: area
list.label: Area
list.query: SELECT name AS __text, id AS __value FROM plant_area ORDER BY name

list.name: tag
list.label: Tags
list.query:
SELECT t.name AS __text, t.id AS __value
FROM tag_definition t
LEFT JOIN plant_equipment eq ON eq.id = t.equipment_id
LEFT JOIN plant_unit u ON u.id = eq.unit_id
WHERE ('$area' = '$__all' OR u.area_id = $area::int)
ORDER BY t.name

panels.title: Process values — $resolution
panels.description: Mean per bucket. The band panel below shows min/max, which is where excursions are visible; an averaged excursion is an invisible excursion.

targets.rawSql:
-- Raw table has `ts`/`value`; the rollups have `bucket`/`avg_value`.
-- The UNION keeps one panel working across all three sources.
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', s.ts) AS time,
       t.name                           AS metric,
       avg(s.value)                     AS value
FROM tag_sample s
JOIN tag_definition t ON t.id = s.tag_id
WHERE '$resolution' = 'tag_sample'
  AND $__timeFilter(s.ts)
  AND ('$tag' = '$__all' OR s.tag_id IN ($tag))
GROUP BY 1, 2

UNION ALL

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', a.bucket) AS time,
       t.name                                AS metric,
       sum(a.sum_value) / NULLIF(sum(a.sample_count), 0) AS value
FROM tag_sample_1m a
JOIN tag_definition t ON t.id = a.tag_id
WHERE '$resolution' = 'tag_sample_1m'
  AND $__timeFilter(a.bucket)
  AND ('$tag' = '$__all' OR a.tag_id IN ($tag))
GROUP BY 1, 2

UNION ALL

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', h.bucket) AS time,
       t.name                                AS metric,
       sum(h.sum_value) / NULLIF(sum(h.sample_count), 0) AS value
FROM tag_sample_1h h
JOIN tag_definition t ON t.id = h.tag_id
WHERE '$resolution' = 'tag_sample_1h'
  AND $__timeFilter(h.bucket)
  AND ('$tag' = '$__all' OR h.tag_id IN ($tag))
GROUP BY 1, 2

ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Excursion envelope (min / max per bucket)
panels.description: Only available from the rollups, which is the reason they carry min and max rather than just a mean.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', a.bucket) AS time,
       t.name || ' min'                     AS metric,
       min(a.min_value)                     AS value
FROM tag_sample_1m a
JOIN tag_definition t ON t.id = a.tag_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.bucket)
  AND ('$tag' = '$__all' OR a.tag_id IN ($tag))
GROUP BY 1, 2

UNION ALL

SELECT time_bucket('$__interval', a.bucket) AS time,
       t.name || ' max'                     AS metric,
       max(a.max_value)                     AS value
FROM tag_sample_1m a
JOIN tag_definition t ON t.id = a.tag_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.bucket)
  AND ('$tag' = '$__all' OR a.tag_id IN ($tag))
GROUP BY 1, 2

ORDER BY 1

SELECT DISTINCT ON (t.id)
       t.name              AS "Tag",
       t.description       AS "Description",
       s.value             AS "Value",
       t.engineering_units AS "Units",
       s.ts                AS "Sampled",
       ar.name             AS "Area",
       u.name              AS "Unit",
       eq.name             AS "Equipment"
FROM tag_definition t
LEFT JOIN plant_equipment eq ON eq.id = t.equipment_id
LEFT JOIN plant_unit u      ON u.id  = eq.unit_id
LEFT JOIN plant_area ar     ON ar.id = u.area_id
LEFT JOIN tag_sample s      ON s.tag_id = t.id AND $__timeFilter(s.ts)
WHERE ('$tag' = '$__all' OR t.id IN ($tag))
ORDER BY t.id, s.ts DESC
